title: Apply to be an Active and Creative Kids voucher provider
summary: This page provides information and steps for businesses to apply and become a provider for the Active and Creative Kids voucher program.
intro:
The Active and Creative Kids voucher program provides two $50 vouchers each calendar year to eligible parents, guardians and carers of school-aged children.

The vouchers:
who_can_apply: Must be an Associate, Officeholder, or other person with authority acting on behalf of a business/entity.
Must have a valid and active Australian Business Number (ABN).
If no ABN, must offer an eligible activity and be appropriately skilled and qualified.
All staff, contractors, and volunteers must have a current, verified Working with Children Check (WWCC).
Must complete the Office of the Children’s Guardian’s Child Safe e-Learning Module and commit to Child Safe Standards.
Must hold current Certificates of Currency for professional indemnity and public liability insurance.
Must comply with the Active and Creative Kids Voucher program guidelines and terms and conditions.
The activity must be a creative or physical activity that is structured, supervised, in person, and face-to-face.
The activity must not provide material, or only provide activity-linked material.
The activity must be an eligible activity listed in Appendix A of the guidelines.
what_you_need: Name, address, phone number, and ABN.
WWCC number (for sole traders) or WWCC employer registration (for organizations).
Insurance details (insurer name, policy number, expiry date, and Certificate of Currency).

2 of the following documents (uploaded as PDF, JPG, JPEG, GIF, or PNG): Australian bank account details for payment of voucher reimbursements; activity type, location, and provider website details; documents demonstrating relevant industry experience of all staff, contractors, and/or volunteers who will work with children.
Two personal identity documents (e.g., Australian driver licence, Medicare card, or Australian passport) for the person applying on behalf of the provider.

how_to_steps.text: Check you meet the eligibility requirements.
Gather the required documents with your:
Select the 'Apply online' button.Note: You can save and resume your application within 14 days. After that time any details you've entered will be deleted.
Log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account.Note: Your Service NSW Business Profile is attached to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to apply for the program.
You’ll receive a confirmation email with details of your application (please check your junk mail folder).
We'll contact you if we need more information.
You'll receive an email with the outcome of your application.
Registered providers can accept and redeem vouchers from customers.

more_info.text: We'll provide successful providers with full details on how to take part and promote the program.
You will be able to keep track of voucher payments to your business in your Service NSW Business Profile or Service NSW Business Bureau app.

The person who applied on behalf of your organisation will be able to add other nominated contacts to a group in your Service NSW Business Profile. The group will receive a list of voucher transactions weekly.

faqs.q: What is the Active and Creative Kids voucher program?
faqs.a: The program provides two $50 vouchers each calendar year to eligible parents, guardians and carers of school-aged children.

faqs.q: Who can apply to be a voucher provider?
faqs.a: Applicants must be an Associate, Officeholder, or other person with authority acting on behalf of a business/entity that operates in NSW and has a valid ABN. If an ABN is not held, other criteria apply.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need your name, address, phone number, and ABN, along with WWCC and insurance details. You must also upload 2 of the following documents: Australian bank account details, activity type/location/website details, or documents demonstrating relevant industry experience.

faqs.q: How do I accept and redeem vouchers?
faqs.a: To accept and redeem vouchers, you need a phone or tablet linked to the Service NSW Business Bureau app, or you must integrate your website and POS system with a Service NSW API.
